blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of the current front and three-quarter renders: the jacket still reads mostly as plain ivory with a broad flat diagonal lavender band and sparse buttons. The newly filled lavender elbow diamonds are visible, but convincing tailored seam detail and rear finishing remain absent.

Current arms-up and arm-cross renders show filled lavender diamond-and-cross elbow patches, now legible but visually oversized and not integrated as quilted panels. Angular and corrugated folds remain around the shoulder, underarm, and sleeves.

Direct inspection of the current crouch and sit pose renders still shows large bright-shorts and upper-thigh exposure; the apron does not cover the forward thigh surface in these poses. The revised central lateral transfer band (5 mm dead zone, 35 mm full-transfer threshold) raises pose-matched overskirt upper-thigh ray coverage to 0.377/0.366 in crouch and 0.258/0.288 in sit (left/right), from 0.335/0.336 and 0.237/0.278 in the prior trial. This modest gain leaves the visible coverage failure unresolved; these prototype measurements do not establish fit acceptance.
The current prone render remains collapsed into a stiff irregular fan, with visible sleeve and skirt distortion. Direct visual review remains REJECT.
Current side renders show faceted skirt folds and an abrupt waist-to-skirt transition; the assembled garment does not yet read as smoothly sewn clothing.
Current back render remains largely featureless ivory and lacks clearly rendered rear finishing or waist-adjustment detail.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
